cik_10: SEC CIK, stored as a ten-digit identifier
net_usd_fy24: FY2024 net income, USD; negative values are losses
debt_tag: Debt concept or combination used in extraction
rnd_usd_fy24: FY2024 research and development expense, USD; blank means unavailable
economy_source: Financial source provenance, accession and links
ghg_fac_n_2023: Matched US GHGRP facilities, reporting year 2023
ghg_mt_co2e_2023: Attributed 2023 emissions in metric tonnes CO2e; legacy mt field name means tonnes here, not megatonnes
ghg_source: GHGRP source references and correction notes
tri_fac_n: Matched TRI facilities; zero is no match in the searched records
tri_potw_lbs_2023: Transfers to publicly owned treatment works, 2023, pounds
tri_source: TRI queries, facility identifiers and source references
echo_novs_2023_intel: Intel-only 2023 notices of violation; case-study field
echo_fines_usd_2023_intel: Intel-only 2023 environmental fines, USD; case-study field
echo_source: ECHO or company-report references; some cells are search instructions rather than findings
osha_dart_2023: Cases involving days away, restriction or transfer, 2023
osha_global_rate_intel: Intel-only global rates per 100 full-time workers; context, not US-only totals
osha_source: OSHA dataset and any company-report reference
whd_cases_22_24: Matched wage cases with findings ending 2022-2024; zero means no match, not proof of compliance
whd_backwages_usd: Back wages for matched cases, USD
whd_employees: Affected employees in matched wage cases
whd_conf: Name-matching confidence; none means no matched case
whd_source: DOL WHD source and filtering details
sd_filer_22_25: Form SD filing-status flag in the team snapshot; inspect actual filing dates, including 2026
sd_latest_date: Latest recorded Form SD filing date
sd_filing_url: Direct SEC Form SD filing link
minerals_intel: Intel-only minerals covered by the case study
covered_flag_intel: Intel-only sourcing context for covered countries
cmr_source: Conflict-minerals report reference or instructions for locating an exhibit
ilab_child_intel: Intel case-study mineral/country child-labor risk context; not a company violation finding
ilab_forced_intel: Intel case-study mineral/country forced-labor risk context; not a company violation finding
coverage_note: Original team coverage findings; use the consolidated dataset for corrected attribution
